name: caustics-background
title: Caustics Background
description: A full-width hero backdrop painting moving pool-floor caustics, with a headline and buttons above. Moving the cursor or clicking sends ripples through the light.
use: A full-screen hero wants an atmospheric, interactive water surface behind its message.
avoid: It runs a WebGL shader every frame, and low-power devices pay for the continuous motion.
a11y: The canvas is aria-hidden and reduced-motion freezes the water; ripples are pointer-only. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A deep teal field is covered by a bright, animated web of caustic lines. Centred white headline text, a small paragraph and two pill links sit above the water, softly shadowed.
behaves: The caustic web drifts continuously, and the cursor leaves wakes of small rings while a click drops a larger ripple that bends the light. The headline's shadow sways with the same water.
customise: Set the headline via title, pass custom content as children and toggle pointer interaction; the shader colours and water look need source edits.
weight: heavy: A full-screen WebGL fragment shader redraws every frame while visible.
demo: Headline Swim before work, copy about 40 city pools, a Book a lane button and Find a pool link.
issues: Small paragraph is faint over the bright caustic lines and hard to read.
polishWhy: Striking, well-crafted water shader with a readable headline and a real interaction.
